mon_ruinous_minotaur.description: Ruinous Minotaur (bruiser) — stats V17/W10/M15/Wi13, Σ 55, life 6 = round(Σ/10). Vitality (elem_vitality) is its highest stat (17), so under Rule 21 casts of those elements lose most of their delta against it (max(caster − 17, 0) per element, Σ/10 rounded half up); World (Souls, Time, Space) is weakest (10) and hurts it most. A Summoning / Resurrect must bank 55 stat points to take it (stat_buy_paid). 4 action(s) per round (Rule 1: a 4-action monster forces the player to replace one action with Empty Posture). dice_pattern null = default BMAP 4d6 (Rule 5: one green Block, one blue/white Move, one red Attack, one black Posture die; the highest face is the action; the engine deals it an 11-card 6A/3M/1P/1B action deck in that spirit). When Posture wins it may pick an effect from its hand and skips the dice until every element is emitted. Innate effect effect_earthquake (elem_earth; damage): "Damages all adjacent enemies." It sits in the monster's hand once awakened and is cast on Posture / Empty Posture (Rule 20); it can only go out while none of its elements is Disabled. No on-action rider: damage is the plain resolution-matrix edge (rps_edge). Rule 3: once awakened it defends its tile, never leaves it, attacks any character in contact, regenerates to full when no enemy is in contact, and the next enemy player (after the one in contact) controls it. If a Summoning (∀ bind) or Resurrect takes it, it becomes the owner's ally (its alliance flips to the owner's side), follows the owner (closes the gap, fights only what is in reach) and when the permanent that holds it falls it vanishes (companion), falls again (raised) or returns to its own side (bound). Once awake npcPlan casts the affordable ones on Posture / Empty Posture (game/monster-deck.mjs npcCastChoice: damage on an enemy in reach, defence with an enemy within 2, control on an enemy in contact), continues a cast without moving (Rule 19) and recycles an unusable effect card to its discard pile when no action card is left in hand. Summons keep the 15-card deck.
